title: Persist and replay full canonical matches with verified recovery
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Export encodeMatchCheckpointV1/decodeMatchCheckpointV1, replayMatchV1 and verifyMatchReplayV1 using the merged v1 reducer. Checkpoints are authority-only, strictly versioned and contain complete state plus exact rules/catalog versions. Construct/validate explicit fields and detached containers; never resume a corrupted or partially verified state. Replay accepted MatchEventV1 sequences through reduceMatchV1, including seeded ties, timeouts, powers, spectator transitions and terminal wins, with authority-time inputs recorded in events. Preserve private audit/source ordering and all RNG state across a restart. Test literal reviewed 5-player and10-player transcripts and compare phase/revision/RNG/tracks/secret state, not just visible score. Never use v0 draw-history state as a substitute for a real match.
acceptance: A full checkpoint round-trip preserves exact next-action behavior and private deterministic state without sharing input containers.
Reordered, deleted, duplicated or corrupt events and incompatible rules/catalog versions fail rather than silently reset or repair.
Accepted full-match replays reproduce timeout/tie audit events, track powers, Disconnect and exact terminal outcome from frozen fixtures.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
